## Methods

The top 15 of 20 enriched terms from an over-representation (ORA) analysis were shown as a dot plot. The x-axis is gene ratio, dot color the -log10 of the adjusted p-value, and dot size the gene count. The enrichment analysis was performed upstream; this figure summarises its output. Drawn in Python 3.10.12 with matplotlib 3.10.9.
